text_blocks.snippet: Diabetes can cause various vision problems due to damage to the blood vessels in the eyes, primarily through diabetic retinopathy, diabetic macular edema, glaucoma, and cataracts. These conditions can lead to blurred vision, floaters, difficulty seeing at night, and even vision loss or blindness if left untreated.
